subject.title: Add auth sync command or auto-sync for API key rotation across agents

question: Should OpenClaw handle env-backed API-key rotation shadowing with an explicit operator-controlled repair or warning path, automatic auth-store sync, or runtime fallback after stored credential failure?
rationale: Each viable option changes credential precedence, secret copying, or failure recovery across agent auth stores, which is security-, auth-provider-, and compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Operator-Controlled Repair And Warning
options.body: Add doctor/status/models-auth detection and an explicit repair path that updates canonical SQLite auth stores only after user action.

options.title: Automatic Sync On Credential Update
options.body: Propagate supported static keys into affected agent auth stores automatically, accepting a larger silent secret-copying blast radius.

options.title: Runtime Fallback After Auth Failure
options.body: Try env/config credentials after a stored profile fails, accepting a more surprising auth precedence model.

recommendation.title: Operator-Controlled Repair And Warning
recommendation.body: Add doctor/status/models-auth detection and an explicit repair path that updates canonical SQLite auth stores only after user action.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history for auth storage, CLI surface, and runtime auth precedence points to steipete as the best routing owner for the credential-boundary choice.
